name: MAGPIE
description: MAGPIE is a benchmark of 200 high-stakes multi-agent collaborative tasks designed to evaluate privacy understanding and preservation in non-adversarial scenarios. It integrates private information essential for task resolution, requiring agents to balance collaboration with strategic information control.
reputation: A new benchmark with emerging interest in privacy-preserving multi-agent evaluation, but not yet broadly established.
notes: Reveals significant privacy leakage and undesirable behaviors in state-of-the-art agents despite explicit instructions
